description: Let an agent iterate on one measured metric in your Git checkout, and keep a log of every attempt. Each kept run becomes a commit with its result in the message, and a keep is refused when the benchmark or checks failed. A discarded, crashed, or checks-failed run reverts the agent's changes, including new untracked files that Git does not ignore. Needs Git, a committer identity, a clean working tree when a session starts, and a benchmark that prints METRIC name=value lines.
